scripts.build:engine: bun build src/engine.ts --outfile build/engine/openstar-engine.mjs --target node --format esm
scripts.prepare:package: bun run test && bun run test:ts && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:engine && bun run verify:package && bun run smoke:engine && bun run smoke:pty:electron
scripts.build: bun run prepare:package && bun run clean:all && node scripts/run-builder.cjs
scripts.build:win: bun run prepare:package && bun run clean:win && node scripts/run-builder.cjs --win
scripts.build:mac: bun run prepare:package && bun run clean:mac && node scripts/run-builder.cjs --mac
scripts.build:linux: bun run prepare:package && bun run clean:linux && node scripts/run-builder.cjs --linux
scripts.build:all: bun run prepare:package && bun run clean:all && node scripts/run-builder.cjs --win --mac --linux
scripts.pack: bun run prepare:package && bun run clean:all && node scripts/run-builder.cjs --dir
